notes: Customer: small e-comm startup selling curated home goods. Multi-tenant storefront, small engineering team (2 FE, 1 BE, 1 ML).
Primary ask: semantic search for product catalog (fast relevance) + lightweight chat assistant for sizing/help. Wants to deploy via Vercel frontend calling Redwood hosted API.
Integration preference: developer wants LangChain-style chaining for retrieval -> generate flow, also evaluating LlamaIndex for structured index + metadata filters.
Tech stack: Next.js on Vercel (edge functions), backend on vercel serverless + Postgres (PlanetScale), uses TypeScript. Wants example Vercel AI SDK adapter for Redwood or serverless proxy patterns.

Latency/throughput targets: 95th pct < 450ms for chat (short contexts), search queries < 200ms ideal. Embedding batch size ~100 requests/hour during peak. Cost sensitive — target <$800/month in hosted costs for proof-of-concept.
Security: needs SOC2 assurances, wants audit logs for admin review. No immediate data residency constraint — US cloud fine.
Quote from CTO during call: "We need something plug-and-play for our devs — a Vercel example + LangChain recipe would be gold."
SE notes: recommended prefix caching + 1536-dim embeddings for catalog. Suggested trying k-NN on small FAISS index in-app then switch to Redwood embeddings + external vector store if scale increases.

Requested artifacts: 1) LangChain/RetrievalQA TypeScript quickstart using Redwood hosted API, 2) LlamaIndex example showing structured document ingestion, 3) Vercel AI SDK adapter example that demonstrates edge/serverless call patterns and bearer token best practices.
